description: 20-query suite for the live dlm vault (diffusion language model notes). Replaces the Semester 1 Java-lecture set, which is no longer ingested.
corpus: data/documents/dlm — stance note, DiffusionGemma / Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion / Flexibility Trap / constrained-decoding dumps, plus claim cards.

categories.personal_vault: Ask/library questions answerable from ingested DLM notes (no web required)
categories.hybrid: Research questions that should use personal notes plus web and/or arXiv
categories.research: Multi-step synthesis over the library (full agent graph)
categories.edge_gaps: Questions the vault cannot answer — must refuse, not invent
